root_cause_summary.architecture_level_hypothesis: The persistent recall ceiling is primarily an evidence-preservation failure at the candidate frontier. Previous hardenings broadened query coverage and improved downstream segmentation, but rank/early triage still acted as an implicit evidence gate; structured/live pages were only segmented if the page first survived that gate.
root_cause_summary.lowest_common_failure_layer: candidate ranking/retention before full-content event extraction
root_cause_summary.interpretation: Slice 1/2 hardenings often repaired downstream symptoms of the same upstream loss: indexable candidates or richer page representations were not guaranteed to reach extraction.

architecture_level_change.old_behavior: Only a small page-level subset survived early ranking/triage; full-body/live-entry rules executed after that selection.
new_behavior: Inspect a bounded first-page frontier of up to 10 results for each existing query family before rank pruning.
Retain results that meet a retrieval-only relevance floor: exact-city evidence plus explosion/impact or aerial-war evidence plus target-date/D+1 compatibility. This never auto-classifies a result.
Fetch structured date archives, update pages and live chronologies that meet the floor before classification; retain every target-window event fragment, capped at 4 per page.

Deduplicate by canonical URL with richness merge: union query/snippet provenance and keep the richest fetched-body/structured-entry representation; a snippet-only variant cannot replace a richer body.
Cap retained page candidates at 12 per episode after the relevance floor; use deterministic source diversity and explicit event-time evidence before generic rank/authority.
architecture_level_change.generalizable_because: The rule uses episode locality/date/time and evidence vocabulary only; it contains no missed episode, date, URL, publisher or historical verdict.
anti_overfit_safeguards: no historical verdict as runtime signal
publication time remains metadata, never event time

implementation_scope.reason: As in Slice 1B/2B, this branch has no standalone executable historical-enrichment runner. Historical discovery is encoded as research methodology/replay artifacts; live explosion monitor/metric code is out of scope and unchanged.

forward_criterion_for_slice4: If a future independent Slice 4 again shows roughly 20–30% strict misses from the same retrieval/retention family, do not add local Slice 4B fallbacks; treat it as evidence of a persistent discovery-architecture recall ceiling and redesign the discovery layer.
